value.query: select * from (select (select json_agg(t) from ( select datname, numbackends, xact_commit, xact_rollback, deadlocks, conflicts, blks_read, blks_hit, blk_read_time, blk_write_time, tup_inserted, tup_updated, tup_deleted, tup_returned, tup_fetched, temp_files, temp_bytes, case when (blks_hit + blks_read) > 0 then round(blks_hit * 100.0 / (blks_hit + blks_read), 2) else 0 end as cache_hit_ratio from pg_stat_database order by datname ) t) as stat_database, (select json_agg(t) from ( select schemaname, relname, n_live_tup, n_dead_tup, n_tup_ins, n_tup_upd, n_tup_del, n_tup_hot_upd, seq_scan, seq_tup_read, idx_scan, idx_tup_fetch, case when (n_live_tup + n_dead_tup) > 0 then round(n_dead_tup * 100.0 / (n_live_tup + n_dead_tup), 2) else 0 end as dead_tup_ratio from pg_stat_user_tables order by dead_tup_ratio desc ) t) as stat_user_tables, (select json_agg(t) from ( select datname, state, count(*) as cnt from pg_stat_activity where state is not null group by datname, state order by datname, state ) t) as activity_a
WLM monitor update and verify local info
WLM fetch collect info from data nodes
